sections.basicsHint: State the feel this formula aims for first; when expanded in the list, this section shows first too.

title: Edit the current formula
empty: Go back to the formula list, pick one, then open the editor.
starterNotice: This is a starter formula the system provides. Edit it directly for your project; no need to copy first.
editingNotice: If you don't want to face all the technical fields, keep four essentials first: name, summary, applicable genres and anti-AI rules. The four advanced groups below give finer control.

advanced.emptyHint: This section has no readable fields yet. Rely on the summary and anti-AI rules above; open the advanced JSON only when detail compatibility is needed.
advanced.toggle: View or edit the advanced JSON
advanced.description: This is the raw JSON entry, mainly for legacy-asset compatibility or fine detail tuning. Usually just look at the readable fields above.
advanced.invalidJson: Can't parse the current JSON structure. On save the system tries an empty object; fix the format before saving.

fields.name: Formula name
fields.nameHint: The main title identifying the formula in the list; reflect the genre or reading feel.
fields.categoryHint: For auto-filing, e.g. urban, fantasy, romance or hot-blooded acceleration.
fields.summaryHint: In one full sentence, state the reading feel, progression rhythm or character tone this formula creates.
fields.summaryPlaceholder: e.g. Dense conflict, fast progression, direct dialogue, expressive emotion; fits urban leveling.
fields.tagsHint: For your own search; enter a few short words separated by commas.
fields.tagsPlaceholder: e.g. power fantasy, fast pace, strong conflict
fields.genresHint: Tell the system which genres or settings this formula fits; separate with commas.
fields.evidenceDescription: This is the formula's evidence layer. Formulas extracted from text or the library rely on it when reviewing and re-extracting.
fields.sourceHint: The text used as reference when extracting the formula. The more complete the sample, the easier it is to find stable features.
fields.sourcePlaceholder: The source sample used when extracting this formula asset
fields.featureHint: Style features distilled from the source appear here; check them to keep them in the formula.
fields.presetDescription: Shows the three keep strategies the model suggests; the currently saved choice is marked separately.
fields.antiAiTitle: Anti-AI rules suggested by the model
fields.antiAiDescription: These are the rules suggested for binding during extraction; bound ones are marked.
fields.noFeatures: This text formula has no selectable feature entries yet. Re-extract to build a full feature pool.
fields.analysisDescription: Not reader-facing content but supplementary notes for you and the system to review. Write why you keep this formula and its most important tone.
fields.analysisPlaceholder: e.g. This formula keeps fast progression and direct dialogue; it doesn't pursue delicate lyricism.
fields.advancedDescription: These four blocks are the machine rule layer actually read at execution time. If field meanings are unclear, read the title and description before editing.
fields.compatibility: Compatibility fields are mainly for legacy assets and experiments: {{fields}}. To control reading feel stably, prefer the expression summary and anti-AI rules.
fields.narrativeHint: Controls how the plot advances, how scenes close, whether multi-POV or looping hooks are allowed.
fields.characterHint: Controls how characters speak, emotion expression, self-reflection tendency and face priority.
fields.languageHint: Controls sentence roughness, colloquial level, syntax variation and whether incomplete sentences are allowed.
fields.rhythmHint: Controls progression speed, paragraph density and whether action or explanation comes first.
fields.antiAiBindingDescription: Decides which problems the system guards against first when checking and revising drafts. The clearer the binding, the more directed the de-AI.
fields.savedNotice: After saving, the formula's expanded details, de-AI detection and apply-test read the new settings.
